title: Butterfly with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- wings -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='38' rx='22' ry='18' fill='#ff6ec7'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='38' rx='22' ry='18' fill='#ff6ec7'/>
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='66' rx='18' ry='14' fill='#c74dff'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='66' rx='18' ry='14' fill='#c74dff'/>
  <!-- wing spots upper -->
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='34' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#ffe94d'/>
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='34' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#ffe94d'/>
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='44' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#4dfff0'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='44' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#4dfff0'/>
  <!-- wing spots lower -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='64' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#4dfff0'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='64' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#4dfff0'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='6' ry='22' fill='#3fbf5f'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='32' r='9' fill='#5fdf7f'/>
  <!-- antennae -->
  <path d='M46 26 Q40 14 34 10' stroke='#5fdf7f' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M54 26 Q60 14 66 10' stroke='#5fdf7f' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='9' r='3' fill='#ffe94d'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='9' r='3' fill='#ffe94d'/>
  <!-- sparkly eyes -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='32' r='3.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='32' r='3.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='32' r='1.8' fill='#2b2b4d'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='32' r='1.8' fill='#2b2b4d'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='31' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='31' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M47 37 Q50 40 53 37' stroke='#ffe94d' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- sparkles around -->
  <path d='M18 20 l2 5 2 -5 -5 2 5 2z' fill='#ffe94d'/>
  <path d='M80 18 l2 5 2 -5 -5 2 5 2z' fill='#ffe94d'/>
  <path d='M84 82 l2 4 2 -4 -4 2 4 2z' fill='#4dfff0'/>
  <path d='M14 80 l2 4 2 -4 -4 2 4 2z' fill='#4dfff0'/>
</svg>
